author: Goodpart
name: Switcheroo
bootlegger: View running notes and homebrew almanac at menagerie.towerrangers.net

name: Swindler
ability: Once per game, at night*, receive a good player's info and three players that may have sent it. That info is wrong for both players.
flavor: Ho there - yes, you in the dirty apron! You look like a lucky fella. And you, miss! You with those lovely scissors in hand! Something tells me luck is on your side this fine day. Don't be scared, I don't bite. Now, watch closely as I place the ball under the cup...
otherNightReminder: From Night 2: Wake the Swindler and ask if they wish to use their ability. If they do, when a player of your choice receives info tonight, it is wrong: send a copy of that info to the Swindler. If no info is left to send, the Swindler learns nothing.

jinxes.reason: The Spy may register to the Swindler’s ability.
If a Vortox is in play, the Swindler produces and receives correct information.

name: Houndmaster
ability: If you die at night, pick a player: you learn the number of steps from them to the nearest evil player.
flavor: A hunter without a hound is an orchestra without a conductor.
otherNightReminder: If the Houndmaster dies at night, wake them and ask them to pick a player. Show them a number.

name: Eccentric
ability: If you are nominated by evil and executed, your team loses. Anyone 'mad' that you are in play might die. You cannot self-nominate. [Your token is a square]
flavor: Up is down! Left is right! Day is night! I am not me! I am you! Or are you me? Wait, I'm me? Round and round we go... Oh ho!

jinxes.reason: The Faux Paw nominating the Eccentric does not trigger the Eccentric's ability.
If the Spy and the Eccentric is in play, the Eccentric is drunk.
If the Widow and the Eccentric is in play, the Eccentric is drunk.

name: Counterfeiter
ability: On Nights 1 and 2, you see the Grimoire, with characters removed: you may move 1 unique reminder token in play.
flavor: If you're not cheating, you're not trying. (Creator credit: George)
firstNightReminder: Remove characters from the Grimoire (including bluffs) and show the Counterfieter the Grimoire. They may move 1 unique reminder token they see.
otherNightReminder: Remove characters from the Grimoire (including bluffs) and show the Counterfieter the Grimoire. They may move 1 unique reminder token they see.

jinxes.reason: If the Counterfeiter moves the Lunch token :reminder: to an evil player, it becomes the Cannibal's Poisoned token :reminder:.

If the Counterfeiter moves the Is The Marionette token :reminder: from the evil Marionette to a good player, that player becomes the evil Marionette: the previous Marionette turns good and regains their ability.
If the Counterfeiter moves the Mad token :reminder:, the player it moves to is informed that they are mad as the character the Cerenovus chose.

If the Counterfeiter moves the Mad token :reminder:, the player it moves to is informed that they are mad at the same player the Harpy chose. If they move the 2nd token :reminder: the player with the Mad token is informed their target has changed.

If the Counterfeiter moves the First token :reminder:, the player it moves to is informed that they must vote with the same player the Blackmailer chose. If they move the Second token :reminder: the player with the First token is informed their target has changed.

name: Baku
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. One Townsfolk you speak to yields false information until dawn.
flavor: If you hear the whispers that float on the wind, they may not hear your screams.

name: Mad Scientist
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player. They are poisoned and alive until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Mad Scientist chooses a dead player. :reminder:

name: Taxidermist
ability: Dead votes can be used to nominate. If you die, travel out or are exiled, choose 1-3 players: they regain their vote token :reminder:.
flavor: The difference between the tax man and the taxidermist is that the taxidermist leaves the skin.
